description: Federal estate tax calculator — US federal estate tax estimate (offline, 26 USC 2001/2010): taxable estate, tentative tax, applicable credit, tax due, effective rate, exclusion remaining, Form 706 need and a state estate/inheritance-tax flag. Exclusion $15M for 2026 ($13.99M 2025). Required: estate (gross estate USD). Optional: deductions (debts/expenses), marital, charitable, lifetime_gifts (adjusted taxable gifts), gift_tax_paid, dsue (ported spousal exclusion), year (2023-2035, default 2026), state (2-letter). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_estate_tax
